To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Measurement, Analytics and Control (MACH) division is KLA’s software powerhouse, responsible for developing high-performance software platforms that support semiconductor manufacturing. MACH delivers cutting-edge technologies in patterning analytics, modeling, and data science—empowering chipmakers to ramp next-gen devices faster and more efficiently. Our cross-functional team of research scientists, software engineers, apps engineers and process engineers are solving the industry’s most complex technical problems.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

About the Role

We are seeking an intellectually curious and technically exceptional AI Engineer to join our Applied AI Research organization.

This role is designed for individuals who enjoy moving beyond application of established techniques and are motivated by solving problems that have no obvious solution. About the Role

Most marketing internships hand you a social calendar and a prayer. This one hands you a budget line, a dashboard, and a "go figure it out." We're a small team moving fast, which means the ceiling on what you can own is basically however far you can reach. If you ship something great in week two, it goes live in week two.

What you'll actually do

 - Run experiments end to end - form a hypothesis, build the campaign or landing page or post, ship it, read the numbers, kill it or scale it. Repeat weekly.

 - Paid - get your hands dirty in Google and Meta ads: creative, targeting, CAC, the whole funnel. You won't just "assist," you'll own tests.

 - Organic and content - write things people actually want to read, turn our product wins into stories, and distribute them where devs and builders hang out.

 - Analytics - live in the data. Attribution, cohorts, what's working and (more importantly) what's quietly wasting money. Own the "why did that number move" question.

 - Vibe-code your own tools - prototype a landing page, spin up a scrappy internal dashboard, automate the boring stuff. We don't care if it's held together with duct tape and an LLM, we care that it works.

You'll fit right in if you

 - Are a final-year student or recent grad (0-1 yr) who's a hungry generalist, not a specialist waiting to be told what to do.

 - Are genuinely AI-fluent - you use LLMs the way the rest of us use Google, and you've got opinions about which model does what best.

 - Can vibe-code your way to a working prototype. You don't need a CS degree, you need to be dangerous with an AI coding tool and unafraid of a terminal.

 - Write like a human, not a press release.

 - Have shipped something on your own - a project, a campaign, a newsletter, a side hustle, a chaotic-but-real growth hack. We want proof you make things, not just plans.

Bonus points (not dealbreakers)

 - You've run ads before.

 - You can make a chart and a joke with equal confidence.

 - You've built or automated something with an LLM that made a real person's life easier.

 - You lurk in the right dev/AI corners of the internet and know what's actually going viral vs. what's just LinkedIn noise.

How to apply

Skip the generic cover letter. Send us one of these instead:

 1. A growth experiment you'd run for Sarvam in your first 30 days (one paragraph, be specific), or

 2. Something you built or grew, with the numbers, or

 3. A thing you vibe-coded that you're weirdly proud of.

Why Sarvam?

Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact.

• Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar

• High ownership and high impact, from day one

• Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems

• You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates

If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

About Fam (previously FamPay)
 
Fam is India's first payments app for everyone above 11. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million+ youngest users in India to kickstart their financial journey super early in their life.
 
Founded in 2019 by IIT Roorkee alumni, Fam is backed by some of the most respected investors around the world like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (Sequoia Capital) India, Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital and the likes of Kunal Shah, Amrish Rao as angel investors.
 
About the Role
 
We are looking for a Security Enthusiast who thinks like a hacker but works for the good guys. You shouldn't just find bugs; you should be obsessed with understanding why they exist and how to fix them for good.
 
As an Application Security Engineer Intern, you will be the first line of defense for the Fam. You will break things before the bad guys do, automate security checks, and work side-by-side with our engineering team to build a fortress around our users' hard-earned money.
 
If you get a rush from finding an RCE, live on r/netsec, or spend your weekends capturing flags or bounties, this role is for you.
 
Note: This is an onsite internship at Fam HQ, Bangalore.
 
Curious to know about FamPay's tech stack? Click here to know what makes and keeps Fam running!

On the Job 
• Break the App: Perform vulnerability assessments and penetration testing (VAPT) on our Web Applications, Android/iOS Apps, and APIs.

• Automate Defense: Help integrate security tools (SAST/DAST) into our CI/CD pipelines. We believe security should move as fast as our code.

• Code Review: Review source code for security flaws (like SQLi, XSS, IDOR) and help developers write secure code from day one.

• Bug Triage: Analyze incoming bug reports from our Bug Bounty programs, validate them, and prioritize fixes.

• Threat Modeling: Work with product and engineering teams during the design phase to identify potential security risks before a single line of code is written.

• Learn & Evolve: Stay updated with the latest CVEs, zero-days, and security trends.
Who you are
• The Hacker Mindset: You have a deep understanding of the OWASP Top 10 (Web & Mobile) and know how to exploit and patch them.

• Tool Wizardry: Hands-on experience with tools like Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap, Postman, or similar open-source security tools.

• Coding Chops: You can read code (Python, Go, Java, or JavaScript) and write scripts to automate attacks or defenses.

• Curiosity: You are a student of the game. You actively participate in CTFs, Bug Bounties, or have a rank on platforms like HackTheBox/TryHackMe.

• Communication: You can explain a complex vulnerability to a developer without sounding like a robot.
Bonus Points
• Experience with Cloud Security (AWS/GCP).

• A Hall of Fame mention in any major tech company's Bug Bounty program.

• Open source security contributions.
Why Join Us?
• Impact: You’ll be protecting the financial data of millions of teenagers. The bugs you find and fix will have a direct, real-world impact.

• Mentorship: Work directly with founding members and senior engineers who have built systems at scale.

• Perks: Competitive stipend, Certificate and Letter of Recommendation, Friendly leave policy, and cool Fam merchandise!

Ready to be part of the Fam? Apply Now and complete this challenge - https://ctf.fampay.co/
